Maya P.: Heads-up — vendor sent updated ETA for the H100 tranche. They've pushed a subset to 6 weeks due to a component hold, but can split shipment earlier if we accept partial QA returns flow. Thoughts?
James (Infra): Can we get specifics on which serials are delayed? If it's a small subset we might reassign nodes.
Lina - Logistics: Vendor says 40 units delayed, can air-split 20 in 2 weeks and 20 in 6 weeks. Need RMA route clarified for any DOA in the early split. :airplane:
Oliver - Procurement: Pricing hold: the earlier split incurs +3% per-unit freight and a $450 expedite fee. Vendor will absorb customs brokerage on partial shipments.
Maya P.: OK. Main risks: a) early split increases per-unit cost, b) early arrivals may go into staging with no spare slots, c) returns/DOA management for split AWBs.
James (Infra): On staging slots — we currently have capacity for ~18 GPUs this week at SFO staging. If they air-split 20, we'll need overtime or third-party dock. What's the AWB plan?
Lina - Logistics: Vendor offered two AWBs: AWB 123-1112223 (early 20) and AWB 123-1112224 (backfill 20). They want RMA flow for early: return->vendor direct (preferred) or depot->vendor (slower).
Maya P.: Preference is vendor-direct return for speed, but we need proof-of-delivery and serialized manifest attached. Can vendor provide per-serial photos + test bench logs on dispatch?
Oliver - Procurement: I'll push for test-bench pre-shipment for the early split. If vendor agrees, we accept the +3% freight and expedite fee. If not, we decline split.
James (Infra): Also confirm network onboarding windows. We can't plug new nodes until Tuesday slot opens. If AWB arrives Friday, they'll sit in staging 72+ hours. Need storage SLA.
Lina - Logistics: Ops note: staging holding cost = $25/day/unit after 48h. If we accept early split and staging >48h, cost estimate = 20 * $25 * days. Might erode the freight benefit.
Maya P.: Good point — show me rough math. If split saves 14 days of capacity vs waiting, that's value; but if holding costs + expedite fee > expected throughput gains, it's not worth it.
Oliver - Procurement: Quick calc: expedite fee $450 + 3% on MSRP ($8k) => 0.03*8k*20 = $4,800 freight delta, plus $450 = $5,250. Staging worst-case 4 days beyond free window => 20*25*4 = $2,000. Total delta ~$7,250. Value of 14 days of 20 GPUs — depends on burn rate.
James (Infra): If each GPU enables 10k tokens/sec for critical workload and reduces cloud spend by $900/day overall (estimate), 20 GPUs -> $18k/day saved? That seems high. Let's be conservative: 20 GPUs reduce spot spend by $1,200/day. Over 14 days that's $16,800 saved — so split looks favorable. Need to confirm numbers with finance.
Maya P.: Lina, please get vendor confirmation on: serialized manifests, per-serial test logs, insured AWB values, and vendor-direct RMA acceptance window. Also ask if they can postpone dispatch to align with our Tuesday onboarding.
Lina - Logistics: On it. Pinged vendor rep (cc). They responded: "We can delay pickup by up to 3 business days, we will attach per-serial QC sheet, and vendor-direct RMA accepted within 30 days of delivery."
rma-bot: RMA policy check: vendor-direct returns require vendor RMA# on manifest and pre-authorized credit. Missing RMA# will route to depot and add 5-7 days.
Maya P.: That's actionable. Oliver/James, if we get the QC sheets and delay to Tuesday, approve split + expedite? Vote: +1 Maya, Oliver?
Oliver - Procurement: +1 if QC sheets attached and vendor covers brokerage.
James (Infra): +1 if staging schedule confirmed (no >48h hold). Otherwise -1.
Maya P.: Lina — get staging slot firm (confirm dock ETA window) and vendor to delay pickup to match. If both confirmed, I'll sign off on the expedited split.
Lina - Logistics: Will update with dock slot and vendor ack. Estimated next update in ~2h. :clock2:
Maya P.: Thanks — keep thread here. If vendor sends AWB docs, upload to #vendor-invoices and tag me.
